system.description:
You spin your webs reinforcing your bow to have enhanced tensile strength. This reinforcement allows your bow to handle far more tension. Make a ranged taijutsu attack using your bow. If the attack is made against a creature within the first range band of your weapon, then you can make a second attack, targeting another creature within range. On a hit, you deal your [Weapons Damage] + 3d8.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you swap out your bows normal ammunition for a drill tipped arrow courtesy of your golden silk. This attack gains a +2 bonus to its critical threat range and if you score a critical hit with this attack, you add 2d12 damage to the result. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, if this attack is made within your weapons furthest attack range band, then on a hit this attack gains Pierce 12.
